issues.title: Ingest Benton County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $123,800,625 across 45 funds. The largest: County General ($68,849,468), County Road ($16,522,730), County Assessor Office ($10,088,619). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
